turns.assessment: The only observed optical change is a pre-FEC BER increase at the S10 receiver trx.och185.z. Its receive power, estimated OSNR, DGD, and SOP rate remained unchanged, as did the far-end interface, channel monitors, and all amplifiers. This is the characteristic signature of receiver-local degradation rather than a line, amplifier, fibre, or transmitter fault; the many affected services can share this line receiver through grooming.

proposals.rationale: BER degraded only at this S10 receiver while its optical-path metrics and all upstream instrumentation remained stable. RX_DEGRADATION explicitly causes receiver-local errors without propagating or disturbing the optical path.
A shifted or narrowed WSS passband can reduce signal quality without changing power, but the evidence does not identify a WSS and the receiver-local signature is more direct.
Channel margin erosion could raise BER while basic optical metrics remain stable, but it is normally a slow decline rather than the observed onset near t=600 s.
